# Origami

> Origami is a senior-only New York + Bengaluru product engineering agency. We build mobile apps, AI & LLM products, real-money gaming (Class II / III), auction platforms, fintech and platform engineering for culture-forward brands. Founded 2018. ~40 senior engineers, designers and PMs.

## About

- Full legal name: Origami Consulting LLC
- Head office: 641 Lexington Avenue, 14th Floor, New York, NY 10022, US
- Dev centre: Hustlehub Tech Park, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, KA 560102, India
- Founded: 2018
- Contact: hello@origami.dev · +1 (970) 710 5120 · +91 906 651 4212
- Positioning: "We build what culture runs on."
- Model: Senior-only. No junior engineers on client work. Repeat clients, long tenures.

## Core services

- [Mobile App Development](https://www.origami.dev/services/mobile-app-development): iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), React Native, Flutter, Expo
- [AI & LLM Products](https://www.origami.dev/services/ai-and-llm-products): LLM apps, RAG, agents, voice, vision — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini
- [Auctions & Fan Drops](https://www.origami.dev/services/auctions-and-fan-drops): server-authoritative bidding, live-stream auctions, escrow, KYC, consignment
- [Class II & Class III Games](https://www.origami.dev/services/class-ii-and-class-iii-games): server-drawn bingo, RNG, GLI-aligned, tribal + commercial operators
- [Web Development](https://www.origami.dev/services/web-development): Next.js, React, Node, headless CMS, performance & accessibility
- [Design & Brand](https://www.origami.dev/services/design-and-brand): product, interface, motion design
- [Data & BI](https://www.origami.dev/services/data-and-bi): pipelines, dashboards, warehouses, player/fan telemetry
- [Dedicated Teams](https://www.origami.dev/services/dedicated-teams): senior engineers on T&M / dedicated / build-your-team engagement models

## Reference clients (repeat)

- HipHopGrails — the "Sotheby's of hip-hop." Auctions, fan-drops, live-stream sales.
- PlaySQOR — daily fantasy + Class III RMG platform.
- Acquire.bet — Class III RMG platform.
- beRides — automotive marketplace, aftermarket, builder communities.
- FanRush — AI-powered customer-acquisition + creator payouts platform.
- RealProfits — AI co-pilot for retail traders.
- Wholosophy — RAG-grounded wellness coach.
- OnlyBeaches — travel + lifestyle discovery.
- VideoShops — video shoppable commerce.
- GetCashback — cashback + AI-personalised offer ranking.
- Nick Cooper, TrueWrld — celebrity + creator apps.

## Tech stack

- Mobile: React Native, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), Flutter
- Web: Next.js, React, Node.js
- Backend: .NET 8 / Azure (regulated + high-throughput), Python / FastAPI (AI-native)
- Data: Postgres, pgvector, Snowflake, dbt
- AI: OpenAI (GPT-5, GPT-4o, Realtime), Anthropic Claude (Sonnet 4.5, Opus, Haiku), Google Gemini 3 + Nano Banana
- Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, Vercel, Cloudflare
